name: romm
description: ROM library manager with metadata, artwork, saves, achievements, and browser-based play support

fields.name: WEB_PORT
fields.label: R1: Web Interface Port
fields.help: Host port used to open the RomM web interface. It maps to the recipe-managed internal port 8080.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_PASSWORD
fields.label: R2: Database Password
fields.help: Generated password shared by RomM and its MariaDB user. Keep it stable; changing it after database initialization does not automatically change the existing MariaDB account password.

fields.name: MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD
fields.label: R3: MariaDB Root Password
fields.help: Separate generated password for MariaDB's administrative root account. Save it securely for database maintenance and restores.

fields.name: ROMM_AUTH_SECRET_KEY
fields.label: R4: RomM Authentication Secret
fields.help: Generated 64-character hexadecimal secret used to protect RomM authentication, sessions, and invite links. Keep it unchanged across upgrades and restores.

fields.name: LIBRARY_LOCATION
fields.label: R5: Game Library Folder
fields.help:
Existing host folder containing your ROM library. Replace the example with the actual NAS path.
Your games must follow RomM's supported folder structure so platforms and ROMs can be detected correctly.

fields.name: DATABASE_LOCATION
fields.label: R6: Database Folder
fields.help: Host folder for MariaDB database files. Do not copy this folder while MariaDB is running; use a consistent NAS snapshot or mariadb-dump for reliable backups.

fields.name: RESOURCES_LOCATION
fields.label: R7: Resources Folder
fields.help: Host folder for downloaded game metadata resources such as covers and screenshots. This data can usually be rebuilt by rescanning, but retaining it speeds recovery.

fields.name: REDIS_DATA_LOCATION
fields.label: R8: Task Cache Folder
fields.help: Host folder for RomM's internal task-queue cache. This is lower-priority state; interrupted tasks can normally be run again.

fields.name: ASSETS_LOCATION
fields.label: R9: Assets Folder
fields.help: Host folder for uploaded saves, save states, screenshots, and other user-managed RomM assets. Include it in regular backups.

fields.name: CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R10: Config Folder
fields.help: Host folder for an optional RomM config.yml and persistent configuration files. Include it in backups.

fields.name: SCREENSCRAPER_USER
fields.label: O1: ScreenScraper Username
fields.help: Optional ScreenScraper account username used for game metadata matching. Configure both the username and password together.

fields.name: SCREENSCRAPER_PASSWORD
fields.label: O2: ScreenScraper Password
fields.help: Optional ScreenScraper account password. Leave blank when ScreenScraper is not configured.

fields.name: RETROACHIEVEMENTS_API_KEY
fields.label: O3: RetroAchievements API Key
fields.help: Optional API key for RetroAchievements integration and achievement metadata.

fields.name: STEAMGRIDDB_API_KEY
fields.label: O4: SteamGridDB API Key
fields.help: Optional SteamGridDB API key used to improve artwork and metadata results.

fields.name: HASHEOUS_API_ENABLED
fields.label: O5: Hasheous Metadata
fields.help: Allows RomM to query Hasheous for metadata using ROM hashes. No account key is required.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O6: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether both RomM and MariaDB restart automatically.

fields.name: ROMM_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: RomM Image
fields.help: Official RomM image. Change this only if you need a pinned version or another image source.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_IMAGE
fields.label: A2: MariaDB Image
fields.help: MariaDB 11 is the documented recommended database major version. Pin a more specific compatible tag here if you require fully repeatable deployments.

fields.name: ROMM_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: RomM Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker names the main RomM container from the project name.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: MariaDB Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker names the MariaDB container from the project name.

fields.name: ROMM_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal RomM Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed RomM web port inside the container.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_DRIVER
fields.label: Database Driver
fields.help: Recipe-managed RomM database driver.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HOST
fields.label: Database Host
fields.help: Internal Compose service name used by RomM to reach MariaDB.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_NAME
fields.label: Database Name
fields.help: Recipe-managed MariaDB database name shared by both services.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_USER
fields.label: Database User
fields.help: Recipe-managed MariaDB username shared by both services.

fields.name: ROMM_RESOURCES_TARGET
fields.label: Resources Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal metadata resources path.

fields.name: ROMM_REDIS_DATA_TARGET
fields.label: Task Cache Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal task-cache path.

fields.name: ROMM_LIBRARY_TARGET
fields.label: Library Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal ROM-library path.

fields.name: ROMM_ASSETS_TARGET
fields.label: Assets Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal user-assets path.

fields.name: ROMM_CONFIG_TARGET
fields.label: Config Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal configuration path.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_DATA_TARGET
fields.label: Database Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed MariaDB data path.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_DEPENDENCY_CONDITION
fields.label: Database Startup Condition
fields.help: Keeps RomM from starting until MariaDB reports healthy.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_DEPENDENCY_RESTART
fields.label: Database Dependency Restart
fields.help: Restarts RomM when Compose explicitly restarts the MariaDB dependency.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_MODE
fields.label: Healthcheck Mode
fields.help: Recipe-managed MariaDB healthcheck execution mode.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
fields.label: Healthcheck Command
fields.help: Recipe-managed MariaDB healthcheck command.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_CONNECT
fields.label: Healthcheck Connect Argument
fields.help: Checks that MariaDB accepts connections.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_INNODB
fields.label: Healthcheck InnoDB Argument
fields.help: Checks that MariaDB's InnoDB engine finished initialization.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_START_PERIOD
fields.label: Healthcheck Start Period
fields.help: Recipe-managed MariaDB healthcheck grace period.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_START_INTERVAL
fields.label: Healthcheck Start Interval
fields.help: Recipe-managed check interval during MariaDB startup.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_INTERVAL
fields.label: Healthcheck Interval
fields.help: Recipe-managed regular MariaDB healthcheck interval.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT
fields.label: Healthcheck Timeout
fields.help: Recipe-managed MariaDB healthcheck timeout.

fields.name: ROMM_DB_HEALTHCHECK_RETRIES
fields.label: Healthcheck Retries
fields.help: Recipe-managed number of failed checks before MariaDB is marked unhealthy.

ui.overview: RomM scans and organizes your game library, enriches it with metadata and artwork, manages saves and states, and supports browser-based access and play.
what_happens: Two containers will be created as one Compose project: RomM and a private MariaDB database
EasyDocker will generate separate database-user, database-root, and RomM authentication secrets
MariaDB will not publish a host port; only RomM can reach it through the project's internal Compose network
RomM waits for MariaDB's connection and InnoDB health checks before starting
The existing game library and all persistent RomM folders will use bind mounts
ScreenScraper, RetroAchievements, and SteamGridDB credentials are optional metadata enhancements
Hasheous metadata lookup is enabled by default and requires no account key
On first access, RomM will guide you through creation of its administrator account
Initial database migrations and large library scans may take several minutes
This multi-container recipe intentionally uses its private internal Compose network rather than exposing a network selector
ui.data_location: All storage uses bind mounts. The game library should point to your existing NAS collection. Back up the database consistently along with assets, config, and the authentication secret; resources and task-cache data are lower priority.
